note: PostFinance's prices for private customers (as at 1 July 2026), read in full for its credit cards on 2026-10-30: the Visa Classic Card and Mastercard Standard (50 francs a year for the main card), Visa Gold Card and Mastercard Gold (100) and Visa Platinum (250), each discounted by 50 francs inside the SmartPlus, SmartYoung and SmartStudents packages, which the game's account isn't, so the full price is written. Interest on a part-payment or in arrears is 9.5% a year on each. A cash withdrawal at a machine in Switzerland or abroad costs 3.5% (at least 10 francs; free with the Platinum); transactions abroad in francs or another currency bear a 1.7% processing surcharge; reminders cost 20 to 40 francs on the Classic, Standard and Gold cards, written at 20, the first figure (the Platinum's column shows none). The Mastercard Value, a prepaid card, isn't written; nor are partner and second card prices. The main banks: UBS, Raiffeisen and PostFinance; UBS's and Raiffeisen's card prices weren't reached on 2026-10-30, so only PostFinance is written. The earlier reading of the Visa Classic Card (2026-10-29) holds and is kept.
